what: A small reference set of practice-phrase boundaries, written by the assistant from its own reading of the Arabic and the English. It measures whether a method finds boundaries that follow the meaning. It is NOT the work of a qualified Qur'an reader, it is not a ruling on waqf or ibtida', and it is small (11 ayahs): treat all scores as indicative. Boundary i = a break after word i (0-based). 'major' boundaries are clear meaning breaks; 'acceptable' ones are also reasonable but not required.

20:10.units: When he saw a fire | said to his family 'Stay here' | Indeed I perceived a fire | Perhaps I can bring you a torch from it | or find guidance at the fire (the five units given by the owner)
